newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson to sell component production unit.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson to sell component production unit.

text.p: The components division of Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB said on Friday it had agreed to sell its mechanical production unit in Soderhamn, Sweden, to EJCOM AB.
Ericsson Components AB said in a statement that the sale would take effect from April 1 this year. No financial details were released.
The unit at Soderhamn produces mainly components for energy maintenance in telecommunications.

Company spokesman Rolf Pettersson, who is responsible for Energyisystem within Ericsson, said the unit has high technical competence and good potential but needed a broader client base than Ericsson can offer.
